pretreatment: electropolishing in a mixture of perchloric acid and ethanol
evidence: Al sheets (99.999%) with 1 mm thickness and thermally evaporated Al films with 1.6 μm thickness on Si substrates were used for the preparation of nanoporous AAO nanotemplates. Before the anodization process of Al sheets, electropolishing was performed in a mixture of perchloric acid and ethanol (volume ratio of 1:4) to obtain a flat surface.
